name: essence-store-root
description: Orchestrates mystore, essence-admin, and the gateway as a single website

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix mystore && npm install --prefix essence-admin && npm install --prefix gateway
scripts.dev: concurrently -n STORE,ADMIN,GATEWAY -c blue,magenta,green --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix mystore" "npm run dev --prefix essence-admin" "npm run dev --prefix gateway"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix mystore && npm run build --prefix essence-admin
scripts.start: concurrently -n STORE,ADMIN,GATEWAY -c blue,magenta,green --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail "npm run start --prefix mystore" "npm run start --prefix essence-admin" "npm run start --prefix gateway"
